scope: Detailed optical support/workfield correction, native contact coverage and retained table/mechanism regression checks.
changes: Replace the oversized 108 x 62 x 104 mm solid focus bridge with a 94 x 20 x 104 mm front carriage, paired fixed guide rails, bearing strips and face fasteners.
Add native contact cylinders for both heater clamp washers and both knurled clamp screws after the measured-equilibrium mesh audit exposed visual-only screw intrusion.
Keep optical axes, sample datums, focus joint, task sites and parallel-gripper targets unchanged.
Regenerate all 10 source-matched stills and add an identical-camera focus-guide comparison; preserve the preceding detailed stage, illumination and hose construction.

findings.finding: Every one of 101 sampled source configurations had moving focus-bridge intersection with fixed guide or mast.
findings.correction: Separate front carriage and paired fixed guides; zero support intersections in 101 final source poses and 50 measured frames.

findings.finding: An initial force-limited optics test passed its collision proxies while detailed stopped meshes penetrated two visual-only heater clamp heads.
findings.correction: Add missing washer/screw contacts and repeat force, mesh and retraction checks. Only intended loaded-contact overlap remains, at a maximum 1.321 micrometers in the thin axis, within the explicit 5 micrometer allowance.

superseded_attempts.reason: Proxy-only contact acceptance missed clamp-head mesh intrusion. This attempt is rejected; final geometry_acceptance.json is authoritative.

notes: Inspected all ten final views, including complete assembly, table/knob clearance, sample rotation, compact stamp stages, light source/fiber and camera lead.
The same-camera focus-guide pair shows the former bridge entering the mast/guide and the final narrow moving carriage separated from its fixed guides.

limitations: The audit covers the listed optical assemblies, sampled poses and measured approach/retraction trajectories; arbitrary robot approaches are not certified.
Reference images establish visible construction; mount dimensions, optical prescriptions and material/force parameters remain uncalibrated.
Flexible services retain prescribed visual deformation without contact or strain dynamics.
Source-only high-Z/tilt commands can geometrically overlap the objective. Their actual finite-force equilibria and retractions are checked separately.
The sole detailed-mesh overlap allowance is 5 micrometers of thin-axis bounding-box overlap at intended loaded objective/clamp-head contact. Fixed/moving supports receive no such allowance.

The full knob/table envelopes are analytical, while the 567 service configurations are a sampled grid with the stamp assembly at rest/retracted; they are not a continuous all-pairs configuration-space proof.
Unmarked mount sizes, screw pitch and concealed thrust-screw internals remain photo-supported estimates.
private_reference_policy: Raw laboratory photos/video remain private. Only generated model renders and non-image validation evidence are promoted.
freeze_manifest_note: The immutable source freeze recorded stills_pending=true at its creation. This later summary records completed render inspection and promotion without rewriting that earlier freeze.
